{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the number of duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_count = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_count}')

# Check how many rows have biomarker_baseline == -999
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}')

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient_id
df_sample_seq = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().reset_index()
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq (retested): {len(df_sample_seq[df_sample_seq["sample_seq"] > 1])}')"}
